days.title: 昆嵩 – 上芒登
days.morning: Fly to Pleiku and drive to Kon Tum for the wooden church and Kon Klor communal house.
days.afternoon: Cross the pass to Mang Den (~1.5 h) and check in among the pines.
days.evening: Grilled chicken, bamboo rice and jar wine.

days.title: 湖泊与瀑布
days.morning: Chase the morning mist and paddleboard on Dak Ke lake.
days.afternoon: Pa Sy waterfall with its suspension bridge and streamside trail.
days.evening: Sturgeon hotpot in the cool evening air.

days.title: 昆普林村与芒登圣母像
days.morning: The Our Lady of Mang Den statue on a pine hill.
days.afternoon: The Mo Nam village of Kon Pring and its basket weavers.
days.evening: Mang Den market and coffee by the fire.

days.title: 达克克瀑布与通哲里湖
days.morning: Dak Ke waterfall in primeval forest.
days.afternoon: Toong Zo Ri lake, pine-forest walks and photos.

days.title: 返回波来古
days.morning: Buy local ginseng and dried bamboo shoots as gifts.
days.afternoon: Down to Kon Tum for leaf salad, then Pleiku airport.
